{{Quote|Myyydril Cave vast. Want quick way out sometime? You want stone.|[[Echrhin Isdan]] to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:RotW">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees]]''</ref>}}
This '''mystical stone''' was an object with inexplicable powers that was given to an adventurer by the [[Tulgah/Legends|Tulgah]] [[Echrhin Isdan]] in [[1 ABY/Legends|1.5 ABY]]. It was a white, smooth stone that could glow eerily.

When this adventurer visited the village of the [[Myyydril]] tribe in the [[Myyydril Caverns/Legends|Myyydril Caverns]], he met the Tulgah Echrhin Isdan. Isdan asked the adventurer to collect smooth stones from the river and pond outside the cave. As a reward for bringing him the stones, Isdan gave the adventurer this smooth stone and told him that it provided a quick way to get out of the caverns.

The adventurer discovered that the stone had the power to instantly teleport him from anywhere in the Myyydril Caverns back to the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Kachirho/Legends|Kachirho]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Mystical Stone was a reward for a small quest in [[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees|''Rage of the Wookiees'']], the second addon for [[Sony]] Online Entertainment's [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' prior to its closure on [[December 15]], 2011. It could be used to teleport the player from anywhere within the Myyydril Caverns back to Kachirho. This spared players the long way back through the caverns and the surrounding [[Kkowir Forest/Legends|Kkowir Forest]] area where vehicles could not be used.
